steps: ["Look in the bottom-right corner of your screen for a small picture that looks like curved lines or signal bars","Click on that WiFi symbol to see all available networks","Find your home WiFi network name in the list and click on it once","Click the 'Connect' button that appears","Type in your WiFi password when the box appears","Click 'Next' or 'Connect' to finish connecting"]
